noticeEnableLocation2: Please go to settings to enable location permissions
unsupportedPlatform: The editor is not supported on this platform
migrationIntro: Version 2.8.0 uses a new data engine and editor. A one-time migration is required before you can continue.
migrationStepEngineDesc: Moves diaries, categories, fonts and all other data into the new database
migrationStepEditorDesc: Converts old-format content to the new editor format; originals are backed up first
migrationLandingNote: Do not exit the app during migration. No old data is deleted until migration succeeds.
migrationRunningSubtitle: Keep the app in the foreground and do not close it
migrationDataSafeNote: No old data is deleted until migration succeeds
migrationFailedSubtitle: {count} entries failed to migrate; the rest are done. Originals are backed up — retrying loses nothing.
migrationErrorSubtitle: An error occurred during migration. Originals are backed up — retrying loses nothing.
migrationFailedNote: The log contains only error details, never diary content. No old data is deleted until migration succeeds.
migrationDoneSubtitle: All data has been moved to the new engine; old data is kept as a backup
